title: Hook alignment sleuth notebook
summary: Personal debugging notebook tracking a recurring misalignment between tracing hooks and log ingestion—notes, commands executed, error snippets, hypotheses, and next actions.
content:
Context:
Observed recurring windows where traces arrive in Tempo/Jaeger but the associated log hooks (hook_id tag) are missing in central log index. Missing-hook ratio spikes (ingest.hooks.missing_ratio) from ~0.003 -> 0.12 during incidents. This doc is a running record of commands, evidence, hypotheses, and temporary mitigations I ran while sleuthing.

Incident snapshot (first observed):
- Window: 2024-11-02T21:12:00Z -> 2024-11-02T21:37:00Z
- Affected services: api-gateway, inference-proxy, request-router
- Metrics: ingest.ingress.dropped_count +320; ingest.hooks.missing_ratio 0.12 at peak; kafka.consumer.lag(obs-ingest) +45k
- User impact: delayed logs in Kibana for correlated traces; spike in troubleshooting tickets (CS).

Raw error snippets pulled from forwarder logs:
2024-11-02T21:14:03Z forwarder-0 ERROR Failed to encode record: AvroTypeException: Field "hook_id" is missing (expected by schema v2.3.1)
2024-11-02T21:14:07Z agent-5 WARN Enricher skipping span: sampling_rule=rate_limit, fields_to_keep=[]
2024-11-02T21:15:20Z kafka-consumer[obs-ingest] WARN Committed offset 124892 but partition end 124903 (lag 11)

Commands I ran (notes inline):
- Inspect consumer group offsets:
  kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group obs-ingest
  -> saw sustained lag on partitions 3,4; consumer restarted repeatedly (OOM hints).

- Fetch a raw message for a missing traceID (abc1234...):
  kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic obs-traces --partition 3 --offset 124880 --max-messages 10 --formatter kafka.tools.DefaultMessageFormatter --property print.key=true --property print.value=true | jq .
  -> sample payload lacked "hook_id" key in the envelope metadata, but span payload existed.

- Check forwarder pod logs for encoding errors:
  kubectl -n observability logs deploy/log-forwarder -c forwarder --since=2h | grep AvroTypeException | tail -n 30

- Verify agent version rollout history (k8s):
  kubectl -n prod get deploy api-agent -o=jsonpath='{.spec.template.metadata.annotations}'
  -> annotation agent.version bumped to v2.3.1 on 2024-11-02 20:58 UTC (coincident with first delta).

- Quick query in BigQuery to count presence of hook_id over time:
  SELECT DATE(ts) as d, COUNTIF(metadata.hook_id IS NULL) / COUNT(*) as missing_ratio FROM `redwood-prod.ingest.traces_*` WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20241102' AND '20241103' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC
  -> confirms spike on 2024-11-02.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Agent-side schema change/flag in v2.3.1 removed or renamed hook enrichment field (most likely).
2) Sampling rule change upstream is stripping enrichment fields before export (possible but less likely; sampling logs showed a deltas).
3) Backpressure/oom restarts on forwarder caused partial writes that get re-serialized with older schema (edge case: mixed schemas in topic).
4) A/ B rollout of log-forwarder mapping was mis-deployed in one AZ causing only a subset of partitions to get transformed.

What I tried and immediate outcomes:
- Rolled agent back to v2.3.0 on a single canary node: canary traces now contain hook_id as expected (good signal).
- Patched forwarder schema registry mapping to tolerate missing hook_id (temporary) -> reduced Avro errors but missing-hook_ratio still ~0.02 (improved).
- Increased consumer parallelism for obs-ingest by +2 pods -> consumer lag reduced but not eliminated; memory pressure observed.

Evidence summary:
- Correlation between agent version bump and spike is the strongest signal.
- Raw Kafka messages (from affected partition offsets) sometimes lack hook_id; those originate from agents on nodes with v2.3.1.
- Forwarder showed AvroTypeException because registry expected hook_id for schema v2.3.1 — odd, since missing hook_id should be optional; suggests mismatch between producer schema and registry declaration.

Quick mitigation applied (until full fix):
- Temporary rollback of agent v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 on 3/5 node pools (coord with infra) at 2024-11-03T02:10 UTC.
- Patch forwarder to accept both schema versions by setting hook_id default = null in mapping.
- Alert: create short-term alert on ingest.hooks.missing_ratio > 0.01 (severity=low) to catch regression early.

Open questions / next investigative steps:
- Was v2.3.1 intentionally changing field name to "hook_uuid"? Check PRs: github.com/redwood/agents/pull/784 (Marcus assigned).
- Get raw payloads from agent host that produced offset 124885 — need host:port mapping for that partition/offset (ask infra for partition-to-node map).
- Validate schema registry entries for topic obs-traces between 2024-11-01 and 11-03 (possible accidental schema push).
- Reproduce locally: run agent v2.3.1 with demo-config and capture output to ensure enrichment step runs.

Reproduction recipe (minimal):
1) Deploy agent:v2.3.1 locally with prod-enrich config and set SAMPLE_RATE=1.0
2) Emit synthetic request to api-gateway that triggers hook enrichment (curl -v -X POST https://local-gateway/... )
3) Consume from local kafka topic and inspect envelope for metadata.hook_id presence.

Notes to hand off to Marcus/infra/SE:
- Marcus: check agents PRs for renaming/opt-out flag for hook enrichment; send me link to the exact deploy manifest used in the 2024-11-02 push.
- Infra: request partition->node mapping for obs-traces, offsets 124870-124900.
- SE: validate whether downstream consumers expect hook_id or accept hook_uuid alias.

TODO (short list):
- [ ] Add automated canary test that emits a span+log and verifies hook_id round-trips in pipeline (owner: me).
- [ ] Harden forwarder mapping to accept both hook_id and hook_uuid (owner: Marcus).
- [ ] Add metric ingest.hooks.missing_ratio to team dashboard and an on-call playbook paragraph (owner: Anya).
- [ ] Follow up on schema registry audit (owner: infra).

End of notes (working, will append stack traces and raw kafka messages here as I pull them).
